essence: Worship in Aśvayuj yields sorrowlessness and victory over enemies.
Buffaloes and other living beings may be used in her worship.
Dying in Bhavānī's courtyard marks those beings for special regard.
Such beings should be worshipped in every place and every city.
The teacher should prepare the ground in an east-north sloping place with those measures.
